name: Sandra Davis
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c174069]John[/url]'s mother who also works as a language teacher at his school alongside her long-time friend [url=https://vndb.org/c174088]Leona[/url]. She's raised [url=https://vndb.org/c174100]Holly [/url]and John by herself for years now, as well as done a lot of babysitting [url=https://vndb.org/c174117]Yuuna[/url]'s children as they grew up. Sandra is a very fun-loving person and likes to tease John, taking a particular interest in her son's love life. Like her son, she's descended from wizards and can practice magic.
